'''Z-Sigma group''' was a group of [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports]] that served the [[Zaarin coup forces]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]]. It was present at the [[Evacuation of Vorknkx Project Base]].
